notes.title: Dino Country is available now!
notes.content:
A wild new Western adventure [b]Dino Country[/b] is now available! Explore the ranch, canyons, mines, ghost town, and more to solve the mystery of the missing dinos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/c15ef3b144750295a70ff30ab9ac0f3c6384974c.png[/img]

Purchase the [b]Dino Country VIP Bundle[/b] to get access to [b]Baby Roundup[/b], a bonus puzzle collection where you take care of the ranch and a baby T-Rex!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/0b5673a378acdd6dd011583021ed87105ba02306.png[/img]

notes.title: Death Dodgers is available now!
notes.content:
A harrowing new adventure, [b]Death Dodgers[/b], is available now!  Marcus accepts an invitation to beta test an exclusive new augmented reality game called "Death Dodgers"...but the game is more than it appears to be.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/de619149ffc67418a121d5a17b9f1736002e1575.png[/img]

Get the  [b]Death Dodgers VIP Bundle[/b] and also get access to [i]Day 0: Beneath the Mask[/i], an exclusive prequel chapter that delves deeper into the shadowy organization behind Death Dodgers. What secrets will be uncovered about the mysterious game?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/f1b7711d111e955d1e422540a125b19c832c12e0.png[/img]

notes.title: Framed just launched!
notes.content:
[b]Framed[/b], a Haiku Classic game, is now available in Adventure Escape Mysteries! Kate's old police commander, Sylvia, is under suspicion for a murder she didn't commit. Help Kate uncover the true culprit and clear Sylvia's name!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/a2105a5e96f62c0e950838ab107cdce04e99dc29.png[/img]

notes.title: Play Canine Cases now!
notes.content:
Get your paws on our latest adventure, [b]Canine Cases[/b]! Nitro may look like an ordinary dog, but he's a seasoned private investigator. When a supermodel's assistant mysteriously disappears, Nitro and his human partner Alex are on the job. With the help of expert witnesses like a goldfish and squirrel, they're sure to solve the case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/6ce909d774ec9d73333208be491093b6218f967c.png[/img]

notes.title: Puzzle Lovers is available now!
notes.content:
Haiku's first romance-adventure, Puzzle Lovers, is available now. Choose your character! Date men, women, or both! Solve the world’s greatest puzzles, in the most beautiful locales!

In Puzzle Lovers, you are on a reality dating show. Team up with a partner, solve puzzles around the world, and be the last puzzler standing to win the prize. 

Purchase the Puzzle Lovers VIP Bundle and get access to Reunion, an exclusive bonus chapter featuring your character and the rest of the cast at their one-year reunion special.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/8937ddaca693f1f98861033ea6df0e4cd57e59b0.png[/img]

notes.title: Play Hidden Ruins now!
notes.content:
We've added one of our original classics, [b]Hidden Ruins[/b] to Adventure Escape Mysteries! Relive the first adventure with the steadfast Professor Burns, daddy's girl Rachel, and tech whiz Peter on Steam for the first time! Together they explore the hidden ruins of the Kumari civilization, rumored to have found the secret to eternal life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/6267122f426bde7d3474216a010bb39cab872397.png[/img]

notes.title: Sweet Dreams is available now!
notes.content:
A whimsical new adventure [b]Sweet Dreams[/b] is now available! Journey through the wild dreamscapes of a sweet 5-year-old boy, and help him conquer his fears about starting school. Use keys to unlock chapters.

It's Revi's first night as Arlo's Dream Manager, and she's determined to give him the sweetest dreams ever. She's planned everything out perfectly, so nothing can go wrong. Right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/31ab732d17f0b4b89579aa638c3e9583b8dd47be.png[/img]

Check out an exclusive set of over 40 bonus puzzles in [b]Stardust: A Puzzle Collection[/b] to dive deeper into the world of Sweet Dreams. Purchase the Sweet Dreams VIP Bundle to play. Explore four areas of Arlo's brain: Memory, Emotion, Movement, and Hunger. Solve puzzles and earn enough stardust to fix Revi's dream machine.

notes.title: Play our new mystery Vanishing Act!
notes.content:
Vanishing Act is available now! Detective Kate and Murphy finally get some time to themselves. Magic shows are full of surprises. When something goes wrong, what secrets will be revealed?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/ef5c64039807932cac339d0ca9f74f57c3628228.png[/img]

We also have a new and exclusive bonus chapter, Homecoming, featuring Kate in her high school years. Mystery lurks in the halls of Kate's high school. Don't let Kate get a failing grade! Purchase the VIP Bundle to get access. [b]Hints and skips are free![/b] Learn more about the VIP Bundle on our [url=https://www.haikugames.com/blog/vip-bundle-frequently-asked-questions]blog post[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/2a8e89f1be58d562400b8f6b6e85355cdbe52eb2.png[/img]

notes.title: Play our newest adventure The Squire’s Tale!
notes.content:
The fearsome Monster King has returned! Join Martin, the squire, as he tries his best to help Cedrick, his knight. Their quest is to seek the legendary Sword of Light and put an end to the Monster King once and for all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/69171ef2cdae64ab9cf0087d9a92c9b15c5d7d57.png[/img]

notes.title: Play Clue in Adventure Escape Mysteries!
notes.content:
For a limited time, experience Clue in Adventure Escape Mysteries! In [b]Clue: The Murder of Mr. Black[/b], meet a cast of colorful suspects while you explore the manor and locate clues to solve the case. Who killed Mr. Black, with what, and where?

This game is only available until June 4th! Can you solve the case in time?

[previewyoutube=6TfpfFDXoSE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Twenty new mysteries added to Adventure Escape Mysteries!
notes.content:
Adventure Escape Mysteries has been updated with TWENTY new mysteries! 

[b]Legend of the Time Stones[/b] is now available! In this sequel to Legend of the Sacred Stones, Aila travels through the past, present and future to stop an evil Sorcerer. Explore elaborate new temples and battle Gods from faraway lands as Aila discovers the hidden truth behind the Sorcerer's motivation.

Play [b]On Thin Ice[/b]! Just as Kate and Murphy head out on their first date, disaster strikes. A trusted co-worker betrays the police station. A ransomware gang turns to murder. And a blizzard locks down the city! How can Kate possibly solve it all?

Face your fears in our latest horror game, [b]Mirror Man[/b]. Julian Torres, an ordinary boy in the sleepy town of Ardenville, stumbles into a living nightmare that will torment him the rest of his life. Who is Mirror Man? What can stop him?

Play these games and many more! Email us at support@haikugames.com if you face any problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/fbef0bf3251cbe18dba8c037a342660614e96aa6.png[/img]

notes.title: Trapmaker 3 and The Covenant Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Trapmaker 3 Launch!
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/243443b4de18a382f3e1d932e0d1cfbc68e6a801.png[/img]

We are happy to be launching Trapmaker 3: The Final Trap! Play the thrilling conclusion to the Trapmaker trilogy. Trapmaker took Kate’s friends hostage and hid them in an abandoned amusement park filled with his deadly traps. Will Kate be able to rescue her friends and escape alive? 

[h1]The Covenant Premium Release!
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/f48d82ea9d40d4078ef33a4c02d66b7fab1b33f9.png[/img]

We also have a surprise release of The Covenant. Sam goes on a camping trip with her high school friends. An ancient evil awakens, forcing you to choose who will be sacrificed to The Hunger each night! Will anyone escape? 

We’ve listened to feedback from many Steam users who say they prefer a paid download instead of the free to play model. If you purchase The Covenant all chapters will be unlocked, and all skips and hints will will be included in the game for 0 stars. The Covenant has many choices you make which impact the story, so it’s highly replayable. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Trapmaker 2 released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37065150/8edde942527e48ef225225c91dd8c3ee16ad0cf7.png[/img]

A new case begins with a dead body by the river. But can Kate focus and solve this case or will she be haunted by Trapmaker's escape?

Play the sequel to Trapmaker for free!

[list][*] Eight new chapters!
[*] Explore Trapmaker's past with Detective Kate and Lieutenant Murphy
[*] Experience more beautiful hand painted backgrounds
[*] Unique puzzles in each chapter - no hidden object scenes here!
[*] Steam Achievements
[/list]
